title: SAP Security and GRC Consultant
summary: Controls who can do what in SAP systems: designs user roles, sets up access and checks for segregation of duties (SoD) conflicts, where one person could both create and approve a transaction, using SAP GRC Access Control. Sits in an SAP security or risk team and works with Basis, business process owners and auditors.
dailyDuties: Build and change PFCG roles and Fiori catalog access
Process access requests and firefighter access through GRC
Run SoD risk analysis and propose fixes or mitigating controls
Troubleshoot authorization errors with SU53 and traces
Prepare user access reviews and evidence for auditors
Maintain the GRC rule set and approval workflows

skills.expectation: Design and maintain PFCG roles, authorization objects, Fiori catalog access and users
Configure and run GRC Access Control: risk analysis, access requests, firefighter access and business roles
Prepare SoD reports and access evidence for internal and external auditors
Gather role and access needs from business process owners
Handle access requests, authorization errors and tickets within service levels
Explain access risks and fixes to process owners and auditors
Run periodic user access reviews and joiner-mover-leaver checks
Understand Fiori catalogs, groups and spaces that roles must grant
Work with Basis on transports, clients and system parameters
Support SOX or IFC testing of IT and access controls
Coordinate with audit, Basis and business teams on access changes

certifications.why: Shows audit and control knowledge for audit-facing GRC work
